name: Aldo Hill
memories: They say in the market: Famine spreads from Gildport through House Goldcrest's lands: Gildport starves, and its neighbours' fields fail.
They say in the market: Stormwatch falls to House Sunspire.
They say in the market: The sickness leaves Gildport.
They say in the market: The sickness leaves Goldrock.
They say in the market: The plague has burned itself out.
I was in King's Mere when it happened. The fields round King's Mere give out: sown too many years running, they bear thin and weedy, and will for a while yet.
